bullets.text: Witnesses at a Pakistani hospital claim the door to a ward where 14 babies died in a fire was locked, while the hospital states it was manned by security guards.
Canada has announced 'dollar-for-dollar' retaliatory tariffs on US goods, some as high as 50%, escalating an ongoing trade dispute between the two nations.
A French court has recognized a former Air France flight attendant's breast cancer as an occupational disease, linking it to radiation exposure during flights.
Voluntary assisted dying laws are expected to pass the Northern Territory Parliament today, which would legalise the practice across all of Australia.
Dozens of Australians are among the hundreds of people missing after flash floods swept through mountainous parts of Nepal and Tibet, with nearly 100 confirmed dead.
Police are investigating the death of a 16-year-old girl found unconscious on Sydney's Northern Beaches.
Nvidia's sales more than doubled to $96 billion due to high demand for AI, with its data center division growing by 117% as clients seek computing power.

The dollar rose significantly, recovering half its losses from Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s bond market intervention, as inflation data shifted focus back to potential Federal Reserve rate hikes.
Russia is deliberately weakening its currency, as a strong rouble was negatively impacting the national budget.
